title: Text: DET Tom Moore ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Off the record, for my info only, can you give me your thoughts on Victor Victor Mesa and Marco Luciano? SF shortstop, signed in 2017 I believe
Now that is a strange combo you are asking about...
What info are you looking for?

Off the record, both guys were their teams top signings for this period. Mesa is a good athlete, CF with good arm, speed and raw power. If he hits, he’s an everyday guy. Luciano has power potential, has hit in games. He’s got a good arm with avg run. Being a 16 yr old, he is much farther away than Mesa (22) but should play in the IF.
